name: coefficient-stability-v1
description: Repeated game-grouped resampling for material-only, compact-5, and full-16 ridge formulas.
dataset: Deterministically generated legal corpus; generated PGN remains untracked.
sampling: Every 3 plies after ply 4, capped at 20 positions/game; alternates side to move.

resampling.position_deduplication: Each unique position is owned by one deterministic source game.
